name: SummaryList
description: Questions and their answers as a description list, one row per question with an optional action: for checking answers before submitting and for showing a submitted record.

layout.description:
"auto" stacks the label above the value in narrow containers and puts
them side by side once the list is wide enough (about 40rem).
